title: Marketplace Orders Guarantee Grant Computation
content:
**Computation.** On a Northloop-fulfilled Marketplace Orders order, the guarantee grant is the amount claimed, capped at the order's net paid amount at decision time and at the option's claim cap, rounded half up to the cent, and funded by Northloop.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| amount claimed | the amount claimed recorded on the Northloop Guarantee claim filed on the order (the latest filing) |
| net paid amount at decision time | the order's net amount paid on the decision date: captures booked in, refunds booked out |
| claim cap | the option's claim cap, USD 2500.00 on every delivery option |

## How the grant is reached

The grant is the lowest of three figures: the amount claimed, the order's net paid amount at decision time, and the claim cap of USD 2500.00; the result is rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

| Amount claimed | Net paid at decision time | Claim cap | Guarantee grant |
|---|---|---|---|
| 120.00 | 145.60 | 2500.00 | 120.00 |
| 120.00 | 110.50 | 2500.00 | 110.50 |
| 3100.00 | 3240.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 |

In the second row the order's net paid amount has fallen below the amount claimed (for example because refunds have been booked since the claim was filed), and the net paid amount governs.
